duct bank: the joint bay JC2 ends at the 1962 duct bank (the tunnel is filled beyond it): its east wall, tagged ductbank and coloured apart
P18E: doorway SD cut through the block (1.2 m, lintel at 2.1 m)
DP3: its foot (33.3, 20.5) is inside block SKIP (Scrap dealer skip on the kerb): the JSON puts the pipe under the SKIP footprint, so DP3 cannot be climbed from the ground
RLY: the JSON block is a thin pad (h 0.05); built as a 2.4 m palisade of upright bars on its open edges (a see-through steel fence, not climbable)
SG: subf is fenced as HV equipment must be: a 2.4 m palisade on its open edges, the gate SG (1.8 m) in the z=21 line
SPK16: spikes are 288 thin upright pins on a 0.3 m grid (a solid 0.4 m slab could be stepped on)
roof lights (RL*): built as the JSON block, a solid 0.3 m glazed upstand. The controller steps onto 0.3 m, so "not walkable" is not enforced in G1 (the engine has no fall-through glass)
